svg.title: Payment Orchestrator — Component
svg.text: Public REST API for payment intents,
Scores each payment for fraud risk before
Chooses the acquiring connection by card
Detokenizes the card for the network request [mTLS]
Authorizes, captures and refunds [ISO 8583 over TLS]
Enclosing frame = named scope or deployment boundary
Arrow = directed dependency; label states its purpose
